summary.text: Samuel (Sam) Gallucci, a Republican pastor in Oxnard and business executive, lost the November 3, 2026 election for California's 26th Congressional District to Jacqui Irwin.
He previously ran in the 2021 California gubernatorial recall election, and his ballot designation was Business Executive/Pastor.

paragraphs.text: Gallucci and his wife, Toni, are listed as lead pastors of Embrace Church in Oxnard on the church's website.
His campaign website describes him as a business leader and pastor who led Embrace Church and founded four nonprofit organizations.
In 2021 he was a Republican candidate on the replacement ballot in the recall election of Gov. Gavin Newsom, receiving 18,134 votes.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026, top-two primary for the 26th District with 20.9% of the vote.
JoinCalifornia lists him as married to Toni, with three sons.
He received 38.0% of the vote to Jacqui Irwin's 62.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
